steps.source: Note: you will need at least two players to complete this quest!

steps.text: Go down into the basement of the lighthouse south-west of Thais.
steps.source: Go to the lighthouse southwest of Thais and go down into the basement.

steps.text: Move the crates in the south of the room: pull the lever under them. A ladder down appears.
steps.source: To access this dungeon, you'll have to find a lever under some crates which will make a ladder leading down appear.

steps.text: Go down the ladder that appeared.
steps.source: To access this dungeon, you'll have to find a lever under some crates which will make a ladder leading down appear.

steps.text: One player stands on the switch plate at the end of the north passage: stairs appear at the south end.
steps.source: The north passage leads to a switchplate that will make stairs appear at the south end once someone stands on it.

steps.text: The other player goes down the stairs at the south end.
steps.source: The other person must go down the stairs and turn a lever.

steps.text: Pull the lever: a teleporter appears in the east passage.
steps.source: Once turned, this lever will make the teleporter leading to the quest room appear in the right passage.

steps.text: Go back up and take the teleporter at the end of the east passage.
steps.source: Once turned, this lever will make the teleporter leading to the quest room appear in the right passage.

steps.text: A cyclops guards the room. At the north end: the dark shield in one chest.
steps.source: There are only 2 Cyclopes in there, which can be either fought or ignored. The chests containing the Dark Shield and Battle Hammer are at the north end of the room.

steps.text: The battle hammer in the other chest.
steps.source: The chests containing the Dark Shield and Battle Hammer are at the north end of the room.
